promptTemplate: Jira issue {{issue.key}} moved to In Progress: {{issue.fields.summary}}. Deliver a reviewed fix on a branch and a pull request. Do not merge.

stages.label: Reproduce
stages.instructions: Reproduce the reported behavior with a deterministic failing test or script before changing product code. Cite the test path and the failing command.

stages.label: Plan and review
stages.instructions: Write a bounded plan with file ownership. Ask one peer to review it with kxm_send, record contradictions and decisions with kxm_workflow_record, and revise the plan before implementing.

stages.label: Implement and verify locally
stages.instructions: Implement the plan. Run lint, typecheck, and the test suite, and make the reproduction pass. Cite each command and its result.

stages.label: Pull request checks
stages.instructions: Push the branch and open or update the pull request. Then call kxm_workflow_wait on this stage with signal key github-pr-<number>-checks and settle your turn. An operator or CI job runs kxm gate github watch, which posts the signed result.

stages.label: Update Jira and record lessons
stages.instructions: Comment on the Jira issue with the pull request link and the evidence summary, using your own authorized Jira tool. Record at least one lesson with kxm_workflow_record. Do not merge the pull request.
